text: Superbet Group is a private gambling company founded in 2008 by Sacha Dragic, its chief executive, who returned to sole leadership of the Group in 2026. In May 2019 funds managed or advised by Blackstone's Tactical Opportunities business made a €175m strategic minority equity investment in Superbet; in February 2025 that Blackstone strategic investment was refinanced with HPS Investment Partners.
short: Superbet is private: founded and led by Sacha Dragic, with a Blackstone minority stake since 2019.
